items.title: 'You make your bed, you lie in it': Albanese's warning to 'ISIS brides' in Syria
items.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese insists the federal government will not repatriate the Australian families with links to Islamic State fighters who remain in Syria.

items.title: Angus Taylor preparing to unveil shadow ministry
items.description: The new Liberal leader is expected to announce his shadow ministry on Tuesday afternoon, elevating prominent right-faction supporters such as West Australian MP Andrew Hastie.

items.title: Live: 'Too complex': Coles lawyer says grocery prices tough to understand
items.description: Coles faces hearings on accusations of misleading customers on discounts. The Australian share market opens higher. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: One man dead, two people critically injured in 'random' Sydney stabbing attack
items.description: Police were told on arrival at the scene in Merrylands that a man stabbed multiple people before leaving the area on foot.

items.title: Crews race to contain central Victorian bushfire ahead of wind change
items.description: The fire at Trawool, south of Seymour, broke out near the Goulburn Valley Highway in central Victoria on a day when half the state was facing extreme fire danger.

items.title: How a single Louvre ticket complaint led to the bust of a $16m scam ring
items.description: Foreign tour guides and staff who were paid to remain silent orchestrated a counterfeit ticketing ring that robbed the Louvre of millions over more than a decade, Parisian prosecutors say.

items.title: 'Too shattering for language': Former ACT commissioner alleges sexual assault
items.description: Vanessa Turnbull-Roberts says she stepped down as the ACT's first Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander children and young people commissioner to prioritise her safety after being subjected to sexual harassment and sexual assault by a public servant.

items.title: Sydney man to be sentenced over 'abhorrent' 40-second rally speech
items.description: Brandan Koschel was arrested after he appeared on a stage for an open mic session during the anti-immigration March for Australia event in Sydney's Moore Park.

items.title: 'How the hell' does Australia dominate moguls? The answer is no secret
items.description: To the surprise of many, the "beach nation" that is Australia is the best moguls skiing nation on earth. How the team got there is no accident.

items.title: Liberals recast 'social cohesion' as US-style politics goes global
items.description: If migration is treated primarily as a cultural fault line, rather than an economic system embedded in national growth, the debate will remain loud. The structural reform will remain unfinished.

items.title: Highly sensitive court data accessed by entity based in India
items.description: Highly sensitive Australian court files have been accessed offshore in breach of the privacy act and Commonwealth contractual obligations, an ABC investigation has revealed, raising concerns of a national security risk.

items.title: Lunar New Year celebrations paint Australian cities red
items.description: Lion dances and red packets are on display in Sydney and Melbourne, as the cities' Asian communities ring in the Year of the Horse.

items.title: Landmark report finds racism 'deeply embedded' in universities
items.description: Federal Education Minister Jason Clare unveiled the report with Australia's Race Discrimination Commissioner Giridharan Sivaraman in Brisbane on Tuesday.

items.title: Skilled workers are considering leaving the trades — and toilets are to blame
items.description: Tradies are walking out. Not over ability or aptitude but toilets — in a symbol of the sector's persistent barriers.

items.title: Concerns after 200 dogs found on breeder's property
items.description: The breeder's puppies were once featured on Kleenex commercials but it is now under scrutiny from the RSPCA and other pet organisations.

items.title: Nancy Guthrie's family cleared as suspects in her disappearance
items.description: Nancy Guthrie's family members, including her children and their spouses, have been cleared as possible suspects in her abduction as the case enters its third week.

items.title: Andrew Denton was the key to The Chaser's War on Everything
items.description: The Chaser's War on Everything didn't start the fire, but the embers from the beloved satirical current affairs show are still warm after two decades.

items.title: Australians remain 'mesmerised' by US politics
items.description: Huge crowds have flocked to live shows for the popular and influential Pod Save America podcast, suggesting Australia's obsession with US politics isn't going away anytime soon.

items.title: CCTV shows man on fire after firebombing of NSW convenience store
items.description: A man engulfed in flames is captured on CCTV after an arson attack at a Hunter Valley business.

items.title: Body found in Adelaide river prompts police investigation
items.description: Police are investigating the circumstances surrounding the death of a person whose body was found in a river at Glenelg North.

items.title: Tasmanian government advised to stop land sale to NBL team owner
items.description: The Tasmanian government is pushing ahead with plans to sell 15 hectares of publicly-owned land to the owner of the JackJumpers NBL team despite receiving departmental advice to stop negotiations.

items.title: Police likely 'looking for a motive' as Gus search continues, ex-detective says
items.description: Police are again at remote Oak Park Station searching for evidence related to the disappearance of missing four-year-old Gus Lamont, with a retired police officer saying detectives are likely "looking for a motive".

items.title: Ex-footballer shot multiple times in Western Sydney drive-by shooting
items.description: Police have been told Matt Utai, who played for the Tigers and Bulldogs NRL clubs, was shot outside a home on the street by the occupants of an SUV, before they fled the scene.

items.title: Cousin says 'all I can do is utter a prayer' as he pleads with abductors
items.description: The cousin of Sydney man Chris Baghsarian, who was abducted in a case of mistaken identity four days ago, says he is praying for the 85-year-old's safe return.

items.title: Rare bird spotted on outback cattle station for first time
items.description: A project with dozens of monitoring sites across the Queensland property confirms the presence of the critically endangered plains-wanderer by analysing bird calls.
